everyday-conversations.label: Everyday Conversations
everyday-conversations.description: Most conversations happen fast, at normal pace, without warning. Captio AI captions every word as it's spoken, so you can follow without asking anyone to repeat themselves.

deaf-hoh-communication.label: Communicating with Deaf & HoH
deaf-hoh-communication.description: Hearing people often don't know how to adapt when talking with deaf or hard of hearing friends. Captio AI turns their speech into real-time captions, so the conversation can happen naturally on both sides.

meetings.label: Meetings
meetings.description: In meetings, decisions happen fast and people talk over each other. Captio AI captions every speaker as they talk, so you never miss a decision or a question directed at you.

lectures.label: Lectures
lectures.description: Lecturers speak quickly, cover complex material, and rarely repeat themselves. Captio AI gives you a live transcript of everything said, so you can follow the content instead of straining to hear it.

doctor-appointments.label: Doctor Appointments
doctor-appointments.description: Doctors speak quickly and use clinical language that's easy to mishear. Captio AI shows you everything they say in real time, so you can follow your diagnosis and ask the right questions.

job-interviews.label: Job Interviews
job-interviews.description: Missing a question in an interview means answering wrong or asking for a repeat. Captio AI shows you every word the interviewer says, so you can focus entirely on your answer.

phone-video-calls.label: Phone & Video Calls
phone-video-calls.description: Phone and video calls are harder to follow than in-person conversations. No lip reading, often poor audio quality. Captio AI captions whoever is speaking in real time, so you do not need to ask for repeats.

group-settings.label: Group Settings
group-settings.description: In groups, multiple people talk at once and the conversation moves fast. Captio AI keeps up with whoever is speaking, so you can follow without losing where the conversation is going.

restaurants.label: Restaurants & Cafes
restaurants.description: Background noise makes speech hard to follow even for people without hearing loss. Captio AI focuses on whoever is speaking to you, so you can have a real conversation through the noise.

traveling.label: Traveling
traveling.description: In airports, hotels, and unfamiliar cities there is no margin for mishearing. Captio AI captions speech in 60+ languages, so you can navigate confidently wherever you go.

conferences.label: Conferences & Events
conferences.description: Speakers are far away, acoustics are unpredictable, and you cannot ask for a repeat. Captio AI gives you a live transcript of every speaker, so you can follow the full event from any seat.

tv-media.label: TV & Media
tv-media.description: Built-in subtitles are often wrong, delayed, or missing entirely. Captio AI captions whatever is playing in real time, so you are not dependent on whether the content has subtitles.

faqs.q: Who is Captio AI designed for?
faqs.a: Captio AI is built primarily for deaf and hard of hearing people who need to follow spoken conversations in real time. It's also widely used by people with auditory processing disorder, people in noisy environments, language learners, and anyone who finds reading faster or easier than listening.

faqs.q: How accurate are the live captions?
faqs.a: Captio AI uses advanced speech recognition built specifically for accuracy and low latency. Accuracy depends on audio clarity, accent, and background noise — but in typical conversation conditions, accuracy is very high, comparable to professional captioning services.

faqs.q: Which languages does Captio AI support?
faqs.a: Captio AI supports 60+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Mandarin, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and many more. All languages are available for Live Captions and Live Translator. See the full list on this page.

faqs.q: Does Captio AI work with different accents and dialects?
faqs.a: Yes. Captio AI handles a wide range of regional accents and dialects — not just standard textbook speech. It supports Australian English, Latin American Spanish, Swiss German, Brazilian Portuguese, Québécois French, and many others.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Live Captions and Live Translator?
faqs.a: Live Captions transcribes speech in the original spoken language. Live Translator takes that speech and translates it into your chosen language in real time — ideal when the speaker and the reader speak different languages, such as a foreign doctor or a business meeting in another language.

faqs.q: Does Captio AI store or share my audio?
faqs.a: Your audio is never stored on Captio AI's servers, and it is never sold or shared for advertising. It is sent securely to a speech-recognition service only to turn it into text, then deleted there. Recordings you choose to save stay on your phone; their transcripts and summaries are also kept in your own account so you can open them on another device, and deleting a recording removes it everywhere. Your conversations are never used to train AI models — ours or anyone else's.

faqs.q: Does Captio AI work without an internet connection?
faqs.a: Live Captions and Live Translator require an internet connection to process speech in real time. Audio Transcription (for uploaded files) also requires connectivity. Offline captioning is not currently supported.

faqs.q: What phone or iPad do I need?
faqs.a: Captio AI runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 16 or later, and on Android phones. It is optimized for phone and works best when the microphone has a clear line to the speaker.

faqs.q: Can I use Captio AI at a doctor's appointment?
faqs.a: Yes — doctor appointments are one of the most important use cases. You can place your phone on the desk or hold it toward the doctor and read everything they say in real time. Medical terminology is handled accurately, making Captio AI a practical accessibility tool in healthcare settings.

faqs.q: Can I use Captio AI in meetings and lectures?
faqs.a: Yes. Captio AI works in any setting where speech occurs — work meetings, university lectures, team standups, conferences, and video calls. Point the microphone toward the speaker and captions appear instantly.

faqs.q: What is Audio Transcription and how is it different from Live Captions?
faqs.a: Live Captions work in real time while someone is speaking. Audio Transcription is for recordings — you upload an audio or video file and get a full written transcript. It's ideal for reviewing lectures you recorded, interviews, podcasts, or any content you want to read rather than listen to.

faqs.q: What does the AI Summary feature do?
faqs.a: AI Summary takes any transcript and extracts the key information — main points, decisions made, action items, and important details — into a structured summary. It saves time when you have a long transcript from a meeting or lecture and need the highlights quickly.

faqs.q: Is Captio AI free to use?
faqs.a: Captio AI has a free tier that lets you get started without any payment. A Plus plan is available for users who need unlimited access. Current Plus pricing for your country is shown on the App Store listing.

faqs.q: How is Captio AI different from Apple's built-in Live Captions?
faqs.a: Apple's Live Captions are built into iOS but support fewer languages, offer no translation, and don't include Audio Transcription or AI Summary. Captio AI supports 60+ languages, provides real-time translation, lets you transcribe uploaded files, and generates AI summaries — making it a far more complete accessibility and productivity tool.

faqs.q: How accurate is the translation?
faqs.a: Translation accuracy is high for common language pairs in everyday conversation. Captio AI handles natural speech — fast talkers, accents, background noise — not just clean studio audio. For rare language pairs or highly technical content, accuracy may vary.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported?

faqs.q: How fast does the translation appear?

faqs.q: Does it work for doctor appointments with a foreign-speaking doctor?
faqs.a: Yes. This is one of the most important use cases. Place your phone on the desk, set the source language to the doctor's language, and read everything they say in your language in real time. You can also save the translated transcript to review their instructions afterward.

faqs.q: Does it work in noisy places?

faqs.q: Can I save the translated transcript?

faqs.q: How is Audio Transcription different from Live Captions?
faqs.a: Live Captions work in real time while someone is speaking. Audio Transcription is for recordings — you upload an audio or video file and get a full written transcript. It is ideal for reviewing lectures you recorded, doctor appointments, interviews, or any content you want to read rather than listen to.

faqs.q: What file formats does Audio Transcription support?
faqs.a: Captio AI accepts common audio and video formats including MP3, MP4, M4A, WAV, and more. If you recorded it on your phone or downloaded it from a video platform, it will work.

faqs.q: How accurate is the transcription?
faqs.a: Accuracy is high for clear recordings in supported languages. Captio AI handles real-world audio — phone calls, lecture hall recordings, noisy environments — not just studio-quality files. You can also retranscribe a file for a second pass if needed.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported?
faqs.a: 60+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Mandarin, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and many more. Captio AI auto-detects the spoken language in the file.

faqs.q: Does it separate speakers?
faqs.a: Yes. Captio AI labels each speaker separately in the transcript so you can follow who said what — useful for meetings, interviews, doctor appointments, and any multi-person recording.

faqs.q: How long does transcription take?
faqs.a: Transcription is fast. A one-hour recording typically takes a few minutes. The time depends on file length and audio quality.

faqs.q: Is my audio stored after transcription?
faqs.a: Not on Captio AI's servers. The file is sent securely to a speech-recognition service only to be transcribed, and it is deleted there as soon as the transcript is ready. The recording stays on your phone, and its transcript is also kept in your own account so you can open it on another device. Your recordings are never sold or used to train AI models.

faqs.q: Can I transcribe a video file?
faqs.a: Yes. Upload the video file directly and Captio AI extracts the audio and transcribes it. No need to convert the file first.

faqs.q: What does AI Summary do?
faqs.a: AI Summary takes any transcript and extracts the key information — main points, decisions, action items, and important details — into a structured summary. It saves time when you have a long transcript and need the highlights quickly.

faqs.q: Which transcripts can I summarize?
faqs.a: Any transcript created in Captio AI — from Live Captions or Audio Transcription. You run AI Summary directly on the transcript, with no extra steps.

faqs.q: How is AI Summary different from just reading the transcript?
faqs.a: A full transcript of a one-hour meeting can be thousands of words. AI Summary gives you the key points, decisions, and action items in a fraction of the reading time — organized by topic, not by the order things were said.

faqs.q: Does it work for medical appointments?
faqs.a: Yes. A doctor's appointment produces a lot of information quickly. AI Summary extracts the diagnosis, instructions, and follow-up steps into a clear list you can review and refer back to.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported?
faqs.a: AI Summary works on transcripts in 60+ languages. The summary is produced in the same language as the transcript.

faqs.q: Can I save or share the summary?
faqs.a: Yes. You can save the summary alongside the original transcript, copy it, or share it. Useful for sending a meeting recap or keeping a record of a medical appointment.

faqs.q: Does AI Summary store my transcript or audio?
faqs.a: Your transcript is sent securely to an AI service only to write the summary, and it is never used to train AI models. The summary is saved with the recording, on your phone and in your own account, until you delete it. Audio is never stored on Captio AI's servers, and your conversations are never sold.
